The plate holds what looks like tortellini or stuffed pasta in a red sauce, about 150 g at roughly 1.6 kcal/g, so around 240 kcal. The fruit bowl, which has melon, apple and similar fruit, is probably 130 g at 0.45 kcal/g, so about 60 kcal. The question asks about "everything on the plate," but I'm counting all the food on the tray. I'm leaving out the water, and the juice glass (about 120 kcal for 240 g) and the small chocolate wrapper are not counted as plate food. Pasta plus fruit comes to about 300 kcal and 280 g.

{"kcal": 300, "mass_g": 280}
